data.one_liner: Flutter location picker and place search using OpenStreetMap.
data.what_it_does: Provides interactive map location picking, real-time address search with autocomplete via Nominatim, and current GPS location tracking using OpenStreetMap and flutter_map.
use_when: You need a location picker widget powered by OpenStreetMap instead of Google Maps.
You want built-in place search with autocomplete and geocoding capabilities.
avoid_when: Your application specifically requires Google Maps native features or APIs.
You are building an app that doesn't need interactive map picking.
strengths: Extensive customization options organized via configuration classes.
Built-in smart search with debouncing and current location tracking.
Clean architecture service layer pattern with robust error handling.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific location permission configurations on Android and iOS.
Tied specifically to OpenStreetMap and Nominatim API service limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires location permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist for iOS/macOS, plus AndroidX migration setup if using older projects.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer official Google Maps integration over OpenStreetMap for location picking.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need raw GPS coordinates and device location without an interactive map UI.
